grain_rationale: One source row is one scheduled flight departure: the profile shows row_count 166158 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicates exist and no aggregation is needed. No single column is unique on its own (the highest distinct_count is tail_number at 3825, far below 166158), so a derived identity is declared over the tuple (flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, sched_dep_hhmm), which together distinguish each scheduled departure: the same flight number recurs daily per carrier (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values across 166158 rows), so the date, carrier, origin, and scheduled departure time are all needed to pin a single event.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days with null_rate 0.0; samples resolve to day precision only.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-character IATA carrier code with 16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA, and B6; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number between 1 and 8500; a numeric identifier that labels the flight rather than measuring it, with 2994 distinct values and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code, one of exactly three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA); null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM (500 to 2359); an encoded clock label rather than an additive quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with 100 distinct values such as ATL, AUS, and BNA; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail registration such as N10156, with 3825 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.009154, likely missing where the operating aircraft was not recorded.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean cancellation flag with both true and false observed; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400); a clock label, nullable at null_rate 0.029388, consistent with flights that never departed (cancellations).

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes from -33 (early) to 1301, an additive and comparable quantity; nullable at null_rate 0.029388, matching dep_hhmm and consistent with flights that never departed.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400); a clock label, nullable at null_rate 0.0307 for flights that never arrived.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2359); a clock label with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes from -86 to 1272, an additive and comparable quantity; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes in the air from 20 to 695, an additive duration; nullable at null_rate 0.032981, matching arr_delay_minutes for flights without a completed arrival.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Route distance in miles from 80 to 4983, an additive quantity for totals such as miles flown; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour, exactly the values 5 through 23; a bucketing label with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute from 0 to 59, 60 distinct values; a bucketing label with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC departure hour bucket (samples such as 2013-01-01T10:00:00 land on whole hours); a temporal attribute kept as a dimension since flight_date is the declared time column, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name with 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways, aligned one-to-one with carrier_code; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer such as BOEING or AIRBUS, 34 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the tail number did not join to aircraft registration data.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation such as 172N or 550, 121 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.160426, matching the other aircraft attributes.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was built, from 1956 to 2013; a numeric label of the airframe, nullable at null_rate 0.176531 where registration data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Seat capacity of the operating aircraft from 2 to 450, an additive quantity for capacity totals; nullable at null_rate 0.160426, matching the other aircraft attributes.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine type with 6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan and Turbo-jet; nullable at null_rate 0.160426, matching the other aircraft attributes.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name, exactly three values matching EWR, JFK, and LGA; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin city, exactly New York or Newark; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet, exactly three values (13, 18, 21) that label the airport rather than measure the flight; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway at the origin airport in feet, exactly three values (7002, 11000, 14511) acting as an airport attribute; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name, 99 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where the destination code did not join to airport reference data.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination city such as Atlanta or Austin, 95 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.02089, matching the other destination attributes.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region of the destination such as US-GA or PR-U-A, 45 distinct values; nullable at null_rate 0.02089, matching the other destination attributes.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet from 3 to 6606, an airport attribute labeling the destination; nullable at null_rate 0.02089.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway at the destination airport in feet from 5076 to 16000, an airport attribute; nullable at null_rate 0.02089.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline capture timestamp with only 16 distinct second-level values clustered in one load window (2026-09-02T23:25:51 to 23:26:06); an operational attribute, null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight departure from a New York City area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) on a given date, carrying its carrier, route, schedule, actual departure and arrival outcomes, delay and distance measures, and denormalized aircraft and airport attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category: it names the time column and day grain, declares the transaction grain with a derived line identity over date, carrier, flight number, origin, and scheduled departure time, and assigns a role to every mapped silver column. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which renders the gold models from it.
usage: The proposal is rendered to an ODCS mapping contract draft (gold_flights_mapping), validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; no table or view is created by this contract itself.
limitations: The mapping maps silver columns as-is and performs no transformation: it does not exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled is mapped as a dimension so consumers decide whether rows with true, and the correlated nulls in dep_hhmm and arrival measures, belong in their analysis), does not impute the roughly 16% of rows missing aircraft attributes or the 2% missing destination reference attributes, does not decode the HHMM-encoded clock columns, and claims only day-level time resolution from flight_date even though departure_hour_utc carries hour buckets.
